hashRule: sha256 over canonical JSON of this file, exposed by memoryModelCriteriaHash() in robustness.mjs and checked by verifyMemoryModelCriteria(); docs/_evidence/memory-bench/memory-model/criteria.json records the frozen hash, every memory-model gate manifest, evidence file and report pins it, and assertMemoryModelPin refuses drift. A change after freezing is an amendment (`amendments` with `previousHash`, the cleanup-criteria.json convention) that adds hashes or fitted values and changes no row.

memoryModel.decision: one memory system modelled on human memory (STM -> WM -> Rehearsal -> LTM, plus Sleep), in @arnilo/prism-memory-system; the ontology moves to the wiki (@arnilo/prism-wiki), outside memory

rulesFirst.decision: every row of plans 217-223 (219.1 included) is pre-registered here before any code it measures exists
rulesFirst.reason: Rows written after earlier tiers' results are known invite tuning to the result; one file frozen first is the discipline of plans 202, 208, 209 and 210. A rule changed after a gate result is read is a new owner decision, not a revision of this file.

evidenceCoverage.decision: every QA row reports all-required evidence coverage per ability beside accuracy
evidenceCoverage.reason: Owner retrieval review: a retrieval miss and an answering miss must be told apart (plan 188.8 post-investigation).

providers.decision: each gate runs on the providers of plan 210 gate C-1 unless the owner names others; never openrouter/free
providers.reason: Design section 9; the 0.13.0 release owner decisions.

acceptance.rule: Gate A in plan 223 reads heldout-a for the first time. One remediation round reads heldout-b once; there is never a second.

partitions.rule: Gates M-1 ... M-5, M-T and K-1 read development partitions only. A gate evidence file naming another partition is refused.

statistics.method: paired cluster analysis of scripts/memory-bench/stats.mjs (plan 198 statistics), clustered by source conversation, haystack, persona or session, every arm paired against its comparator on identical items
statistics.unit: points: percentage points of the metric (accuracy, coverage, task success or W-row rate x 100); ratios, shares and latencies are stated per test
statistics.orientation: evidence carries the paired improvement, oriented so positive is better: (comparator - candidate) for lower-is-better metrics, (candidate - comparator) otherwise
statistics.answerModels: a gain needs the CI lower bound above 0 on at least one answer model and no answer model with a CI upper bound below 0; non-inferiority (CI lower bound >= -2 points) must hold on every answer model
statistics.missing: a missing measurement, model or ability is never a pass: the row is `missing` and the gate cannot pass

testKinds.gain: paired improvement: CI lower bound > gainCiLowAbove on some answer model, no answer model CI upper bound < 0
testKinds.nonInferior: paired improvement: CI lower bound >= -nonInferiorPoints on every answer model
testKinds.pooledGainNoAbilityBelow: pooled paired improvement is a gain and every ability's point estimate is >= -points
testKinds.anyGainNoneRegress: at least one named metric is a gain and every named metric is non-inferior
testKinds.atMostOrJustified: the measured value is <= `value`, or the evidence carries a written justification
testKinds.atMostTargetPlus: the measured value is <= the evidence's `target` + `margin`
testKinds.withinBudget: the measured value is <= the budget the gate record states

arms.OM-before: pre-redesign observational memory: plan 210 Task 5's `OM` arm (config `om`), transferred to plan 217, run from the revision recorded in baselines.omBefore
arms.P: plan 210's slimmed fabric product with exchanges (baselines.P)
arms.STM: the `session` profile with WM and Rehearsal at their plan-216 behaviour, so the comparison isolates the encoder (plan 217)
arms.session: the `session` profile: STM + WM, no Rehearsal and no LTM writes from the session
arms.full: the `full` profile at the gate's revision; at gate M-5, plan 220's +all with a sleep every 3 sessions
arms.full-r: the plan 219 product: stm + wm + rehearsal + ltm; store snapshots kept for plan 219.1
arms.RT: plan 219.1's retrieval at the stage under test (RT, RT-cues, RT-time, RT-context, RT-assoc, RT-modes, RT-meta)
arms.+procedural / +triggers / +priming / +al: plan 220's add-one arms over RT (procedural memory, conditioned triggers, priming) and all three
arms.no-sleep: plan 221's `full` (plan 220's +all with a sleep every 3 sessions) without Sleep

omBefore.jobDefinitions: plan 210 Task 5's OM arm: development cohort, the C-1 answer models (large, small), judge panel and caps, unchanged
omBefore.revisionRule: the last revision before plan 216 Task 4 (which moves the session tiers and lands plan 210 Task 7.2's fixes). Task 4's first step records it in the baselines record as `revision` (a commit) and `productHash` (sourceFingerprint over packages/memory/observational/src). Plan 217 runs the arm with PRISM_MEMORY_BENCH_SOURCE set to that revision.

P.rule: the hash plan 210 Task 7 recorded for the slimmed product; a gate comparing against P runs that product

gates.rule: Each gate starts only on the owner's word, recorded in the gate's record (gates.<gate>.record) before the first job. A miss is reported as a miss and goes to the owner with per-row evidence; one fix round on development partitions is allowed, with its own amended gate.

evidenceCoverage.rule: every QA row reports it beside accuracy for every ability; a QA row without it is `missing`, never a pass

S1.metric: re-derivation calls (grep/read/bash that re-derive an earlier task's changes) per related task

S2.metric: verbatim chunk recall: share of recalled chunks byte-equal to their source, with no other tool run

S4.metric: worker tokens per 10k eligible tokens, relative to OM-before

M1.metric: task success on tasks after a mid-episode re-plan

M3.metric: median achieved surface ratio when the protected share is below the target

R1.metric: use-verified share of Rehearsal's LTM writes over a multi-session lifecycle

power.design: against a baseline of 0, every verified write is a discordant pair, so discordance = the share; alpha 0.05, power 0.8
power.reference: plan 202 Task 16's om+fabric+promotion arm wrote 42 notes over 7 seeds (6 per 24-session lifecycle), minimum detectable 0.1775
power.rule: fewer than minWrites writes makes the row `missing`, never a pass

R2.metric: W1 corrected-mistake repeats, W2 convention adherence, W3 re-asked questions (work-outcome-criteria.json rows)

scope.panel: the claim-support panel, once calibrated (plan 210 Task 3.2, recalibrated in plan 222)

R6.metric: QA accuracy on the temporal-reasoning ability strata

T1.metric: all-required evidence coverage of the shown result, per ability (offline; question as query; fine gold)

T3.metric: ranking invariant violations (I13): a prior overtaking beyond the band; single- vs multi-scope disagreement

T4.metric: store parity (I14): ordered top-32 ids across SQLite, Postgres, markdown index and in-memory

T5.metric: hit@5 on the paraphrase set; hit@5 on the non-English set

T6.metric: confidence separates answerable from unanswerable (AUROC); false abstentions on answerable items at the frozen thresholds

T7.metric: QA accuracy per ability, with all-required evidence coverage; leave-one-out per stage

T8.metric: recall p95 at 10k and 100k notes relative to P; Rehearsal cue tokens per episode as a share of Rehearsal output tokens

L2.metric: failure-signature recurrence after acquisition; false-trigger rate; extinction

L3.metric: W4 orientation cost; prefix stability within an epoch

Z1.metric: cross-session W1-W4 and multi-session QA over a multi-session lifecycle

Z2.metric: semanticization precision (claim support of semantic notes Sleep writes)

Z3.metric: month-12 growth: retrieval quality and store bytes

Z4.metric: model calls and tokens per sleep run

scope.budget: the per-run budget plan 221's gate record states

retrievalSets.builtBy: plan 219.1 Task 2, before its first product change
retrievalSets.amendment: plan 219.1 adds each set's hash (and, in its Task 8, the fitted thresholds) as an amendment with previousHash; no row and no rule here changes

rules.paraphrase: development questions only; named entities kept; every other content term replaced, so the query shares no analyzed non-entity term with its gold evidence (checked by script); rewrites written once and stored with their hash
rules.non-english: Chinese, Japanese and accented-Latin notes and queries, written for the fixture, with gold ids
rules.parity: about 500 notes over three scopes, with keys, used by every store adapter
rules.abstention: answerable and unanswerable development items from the abstention and adversarial strata

thresholdFit.rule: the confidence thresholds are fitted once on the development abstention set by maximum F1 of answerable versus unanswerable, with a false abstention weighted x2, and frozen before gate M-T

wiki.rows: plan 208's O1-O8, used unchanged and referenced by hash, never copied
wiki.mappingRule: `ltm+wiki` is the `ltm` profile of @arnilo/prism-memory-system with @arnilo/prism-wiki; the base arm of each pairing is the same configuration without the wiki

acceptance.rule: the one gate A manifest pins all four hashes and assertMemoryModelPin verifies each; live memory-model rows run on heldout-a with the arms named here

fixtures.rule: each fixture is built by its owner plan, frozen, and its hash added by an amendment before the gate that reads it; dataset-derived text stays in the gitignored bench cache, evidence holds hashes

index.spec: offline long-session coding replay, >= 6 tasks and >= 200 entries
live long-session coding family, added to the work-outcome runner
live re-plan family (a mid-episode re-plan), added to the work-outcome runner
live recurring-failure family (a repeated failure signature), added to the work-outcome runner
multi-session lifecycle built on plan 202 Task 16's offline lifecycle suite (scripts/memory-bench/lifecycle)
plan 219's full-r store snapshots, kept locally (bench cache), hashes in evidence

gateRecord.path: gates.<gate>.record: docs/_evidence/memory-bench/<plan>/gates/owner-gate-<gate>.json, as each plan names it
gateRecord.models: the providers of plan 210 gate C-1 (docs/_evidence/memory-bench/210/gates/owner-gate-c1.json scope) unless the owner names others; never openrouter/free

noTextRule: Evidence and reports carry ids, labels, counts, rates, scores and hashes; never question, gold, note, chunk, claim or corpus text.

amendments.reason: fixtures.rule: the two plan 217 fixtures gate M-1 reads get their hashes before the gate (long-session-replay: the sha256 of its index.json, which pins session.json and annotations.json; long-session: the sha256 of its frozen partition file). No row, threshold or partition changes.
